name: Gross Margin & Profitability core scenarios
description: Real Gross Margin & Profitability Q&A pairs grounded in sales revenue, product costs, markdown discounts, category margin targets, and industry benchmarks: gross margin by SKU/category, markdown discount impact on net margin, category margin target vs actual variance, and retail industry gross margin benchmarking.

parts.text: What is our gross margin percentage by product category and top SKUs for the current quarter?

Apparel generated the highest gross margin rate at 48.5% ($1.2M gross profit), while Consumer Electronics recorded 32.1% gross margin due to higher wholesale COGS, based on internal sales and product cost data.
How did promotional markdown discounts impact our net margin across departments last month?

End-of-season markdown discounts reduced overall net margin by 3.4 percentage points, with Seasonal Goods experiencing the largest compression from a target net margin of 22.0% down to an actual 15.8%.
Which product categories fell short of their gross margin target for year-to-date sales?

Home & Kitchen missed its target margin of 45.0% by 2.8 percentage points (actual 42.2%), driven by increased promotional discounting and vendor cost increases, based on internal category margin target data.
How does our retail enterprise gross margin rate compare to general retail industry benchmarks?

Our enterprise gross margin of 42.8% compares favorably to the general retail industry benchmark of 38.0%-40.5%, supported by strong private-label performance in Apparel, based on internal profitability metrics and external industry market research.
